description: Schéma directeur IRVE is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Toulouse Métropole. Article 68 of the Mobility Guidance Law provides for the possibility for public authorities or establishments to draw up a master plan for the development of charging infrastructure for electric vehicles (SDIRVE) open to the public. Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal shows the English title as "IRVE Master Plan" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Toulouse Métropole. Its keywords include points-de-charge, schema-directeur, vehicules-electriques, irve, bornes-de-recharge, transport. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2024-10-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
